configurations.name: Debug (hot reload)
postRunCommands: process handle -p true -s false -n false SIGTRAP
process handle -p true -s false -n false SIGCHLD

configurations.name: Android Run on Device
configurations.command: adb get-state && test -d /usr/lib/android-sdk/build-tools || (echo 'Missing Android build-tools in /usr/lib/android-sdk/build-tools. Install them, then rerun this launch config.' && exit 1); test -d /usr/lib/android-sdk/platforms || (echo 'Missing Android platforms in /usr/lib/android-sdk/platforms. Install package android-sdk-platform-23 (or newer), then rerun.' && exit 1); cargo apk run
